articles.title: XRP whale wallet withdrawals top 720M as risk-adjusted return data points to opportunity
articles.snippet: Whales pulled more than 720 million XRP from exchanges, as various data points converge to predict a potential 50% rally.

articles.title: Binance says it considers EU license compliant amid reports of potential rejection
articles.snippet: Without specifically calling out a report on Binance’s EU license, the crypto exchange warned that any rejection forcing it to delay activities in the region could “weaken liquidity” and present other potential risks.

articles.title: BlackRock Debuts BITA Bitcoin ETF, Trading Partial Upside for Double-Digit Yield
articles.snippet: BlackRock launched an ETF that limits Bitcoin gains in exchange for double-digit payouts by selling call options on its holdings.

articles.title: Elon Musk Loses Again to OpenAI as Judge Dismisses xAI Trade Secret Lawsuit
articles.snippet: A federal judge handed Elon Musk his second defeat against OpenAI after finding xAI failed to show OpenAI improperly obtained confidential info.

articles.title: Bitcoin Tops $65K on US-Iran Deal, But Traders Remain Skeptical
articles.snippet: A crypto relief rally has “partially arrived” as Trump announces a deal with Iran, but prediction market traders remain unconvinced.
